actor: coding-agent harness product lead at a rival frontier lab
job: Building a durable cloud-sandbox execution mode so an agent task keeps running and stays resumable after the developer's client disconnects or workstation powers off.
outcome: A generally available cloud-sandbox execution feature where a long-running agent task survives client disconnect and resumes on reconnect.
motivation: The agent contest has shifted from model quality to owning the restart-surviving execution layer; shipping it keeps the harness competitive with OpenAI/Ona.

task.what: Build persistent cloud sandboxes hosting resumable long-horizon agent runs.
task.where: The lab's hosted agent-execution backend / cloud sandbox tier.
task.why: Own the durable restart-surviving execution layer buyers now expect.
task.how: Persistent cloud sandbox VMs with checkpoint/resume of agent state

actor: local agent-runtime product lead at an open-weight model lab or coding-agent vendor
job: Packaging a local persistent-agent runtime that runs a multi-agent swarm on the user's own machine with scheduled overnight execution and resumable long-horizon runs.
outcome: A downloadable local runtime shipping a persistent on-device multi-agent swarm with cron-scheduled, keep-awake, resumable overnight jobs.
motivation: Local on-device execution captures the always-on, privacy-keeping autonomy niche and contests the durable-substrate category from the opposite end to cloud sandboxes.

task.who: desktop agent / on-device runtime engineering team
task.what: Package a local multi-agent swarm with scheduled resumable runs.
task.where: Downloadable desktop client running on the user's own machine.
task.why: Own the always-on local durable-execution substrate buyers expect.
task.how: On-device open-weight model, built-in cron + keep-awake, browser bridge
